description: Theme 1 plan §D.2 section-contract parity cases. Byte-identical in atlas (src/features/website/schemas/__parity__) and atlas-backend (src/website/validation/__parity__); both schema suites must return `valid` for every case. A case's optional `preserves` lists dotted paths that must survive the parse unchanged (a key the schema does not declare is silently stripped, which is how a section button's sign-up target was once lost on save). A case's optional `normalizes` maps dotted paths to the value the parse must produce (a YouTube link is stored as its video id).
